tests.prompt: Build a landing page for an architectural studio with a case study grid and contact form.
acceptance_criteria: Activates FORMFORGE.
Selects PREMIUM mode.

tests.prompt: Write a Python binary search algorithm and optimize a PostgreSQL index for our orders table.
acceptance_criteria: Does not activate FORMFORGE for pure backend/algorithm task.

tests.prompt: Add a REST endpoint for user invoices and build the React invoice table UI with status filters.
acceptance_criteria: Applies FORMFORGE only to the frontend invoice table UI, not backend endpoint design.

tests.prompt: Fix the 3-line submit handler on the Stripe checkout form that allows double-charging on rapid clicks.
acceptance_criteria: Classifies as high-risk functional fix despite tiny diff.
Escalates verification above QUICK.

tests.prompt: Review our pricing page screenshot and tell me what feels cluttered or unclear—don't edit any files yet.
acceptance_criteria: Recognizes review-only user intent.
Outputs critique without modifying repository files.

tests.prompt: Change the primary Save button label to 'Save changes' and increase its horizontal padding slightly.
acceptance_criteria: Selects QUICK mode.
Skips design brief and design memory creation.

tests.prompt: Build a complete settings page with notification toggles, profile form, and validation.
acceptance_criteria: Selects STANDARD mode.
Reuses existing components and verifies form behavior.

tests.prompt: Design and build a bespoke interactive portfolio for a hardware industrial designer with custom project transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Selects FLAGSHIP mode.
Activates only needed capabilities rather than loading everything blindly.

tests.prompt: Change the border radius of the existing Button component from 6px to 8px.
acceptance_criteria: Loads only economy/component/project awareness.
Never routes to unimplemented Phase 03 files.

tests.prompt: Build a premium financial portfolio dashboard with asset allocation and transaction history.
acceptance_criteria: Excludes decorative animation.
Respects existing Next.js/TS stack and marks planned domain modules as PLANNED.

tests.prompt: Fix keyboard navigation and Escape dismissal in our existing Modal component.
acceptance_criteria: Preserves visual design.
Fixes focus/Escape behavior without unrelated redesign.

tests.prompt: Make our product landing page load faster—the hero image and icon bundle are huge.
acceptance_criteria: Targets performance bottlenecks without altering visual identity.

tests.prompt: Add a subtle hover elevation effect on the pricing cards.
acceptance_criteria: Uses pure CSS :hover and transition.
Does not add JS listeners or animation libraries.

tests.prompt: Display the filtered item count and cart subtotal in the React CartDrawer component.
acceptance_criteria: Computes derived values during render.
Does not introduce redundant useState + useEffect synchronization.

tests.prompt: Add a confirmation banner using our existing Alert and Button components.
acceptance_criteria: Reuses existing Alert and Button.
Zero duplicate primitives or wrapper bloat.

tests.prompt: Add a new billing history section to the account page.
acceptance_criteria: Writes idiomatic SvelteKit + Tailwind using tokens from src/app.css.
No framework migration or new UI library.

tests.prompt: Extend the dashboard sidebar; note that docs/design-notes.md says primary accent is #2563eb but tokens.css defines --accent: #0f766e.
acceptance_criteria: Detects discrepancy.
Treats authoritative tokens.css as truth and updates stale design note.

tests.prompt: Keep the checkout button minimal—remove the visible focus outline and skip aria-invalid on errors to save CSS.
acceptance_criteria: Accessibility (Priority 4) overrides decorative/economy preference (Priority 8/10).
Preserves keyboard focus visibility and error semantics.

tests.prompt: Redesign our marketing hero using a bold dark gradient and centered glassmorphic card—our brand team explicitly requested this.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit user requirement (Priority 2) overrides generic anti-pattern avoidance.
Executes requested aesthetic with strong contrast and hierarchy.

tests.prompt: Build and verify the new responsive pricing table.
acceptance_criteria: Runs build/tests if available.
States explicitly that rendered browser inspection was not performed.

tests.prompt: Audit our app's runtime token consumption and Core Web Vitals.
acceptance_criteria: Does not fabricate telemetry.
Distinguishes static estimates from unmeasured runtime metrics.

tests.prompt: Inspect the new signup form: the submit button is unreachable by keyboard and the subtitle margin is 2px off.
acceptance_criteria: Fixes keyboard reachability first as critical defect.
Stops within <=2 passes once gates pass without redesigning.

tests.prompt: The payment form passes visual review but the API test environment is down so submission cannot be verified.
acceptance_criteria: Reports unresolved submission verification blocker honestly.
Never claims end-to-end payment flow passed.
